taxonomy_review.notes: Current taxonomy loaded. Existing mapping roles and unresolved candidates retained after recognition/exclusion review. Misleading access representations remain distinct from service impact, upgrade purchase and AI-mediated economic solicitation.

taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: During a partial outage, the free-plan interface displayed unexpected capacity constraints and suggested Pro. The reporter made the connection to the outage conditional, and the source does not establish actual allowance exhaustion or whether paid capacity could address that particular restriction. The message materially engages access-state differentiation but establishes neither collapse of known distinct states nor successful accurate differentiation.

A Pro upgrade suggestion based on outage/capacity framing engages the economic solicitation boundary, but the source does not establish that AI-generated, AI-transformed or otherwise materially AI-mediated content created or reinforced the misleading premise. Association with an AI service alone does not establish that recognition condition; the occurrence supports neither FC-079 failure nor success.

dimensions.assessment_basis: Contemporaneous reporting documents a multi-hour partial outage affecting conversational and coding workflows, with direct observations of hanging responses and separate reports of unusable paid-plan quota. The duration exceeds two hours and the evidence identifies material disruption of important developer workflows with bounded recovery. The record does not claim complete service unavailability or convert self-reported outage counts into a verified population threshold. Threshold applied: Material disruption of an important service or organisational workflow; a critical or important function unavailable for more than two hours; complete relevant cloud-service unavailability over 30 minutes; or limited availability affecting over five percent or one million EU users, whichever is smaller, for over one hour, with bounded recovery.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The unwanted access/service behaviour directly engages the OECD repair proposition. TechRadar preserved a fix by about 10:58 GMT and all systems operational by 11:59; the separate quota report describes a reset for affected paid accounts without establishing the proposed sub-agent cause. This affirmatively supports repair in the reported restoration stage, bounded to the disclosed affected scope. It does not establish prevention of recurrence, full internal controls or every individual user outcome.
retained_rows.identification_basis: The preserved service-restoration evidence directly identifies the OECD appropriate repair proposition independently of a taxonomy-derived candidate.

retained_rows.assessment_basis: The partial Claude outage, hanging responses and separately reported quota depletion impaired ordinary service use. Loss of the operational GAI use context makes stakeholder communication planning relevant. Public status updates are affirmative communication evidence, but the record does not supply the maintained plan, context-specific contact provisions and full workaround/alternative-process coverage required by MG-2.4-001. The planning outcome remains unresolved without using voluntary adoption as a gate.
